meta.purpose: The first names in the Indigenes Directory. A directory that opens empty converts badly; a directory that already carries your name converts well. These are seed stubs only — name, role, chapter and the source the name came from. Nothing else is published: no photograph, no location, no contact, no biography. Each one carries a Claim action and a Remove action.
meta.authorised_by: Product Owner, 2026-09-03 — publish all founding names now.
meta.publication_rule: A seed stub may show ONLY: display name, role/office, body, chapter, source label, and — where the person already has a published profile on this site — a link to it. Any further field must come from the person themselves after they claim. Do not add photographs, employers, cities or contact details to this file.
meta.objection_route: Every stub links to /indigenes/submit?intent=remove — a one-click request to have the name taken down, honoured without question. This is what makes publishing a name the person did not personally submit defensible; do not remove it.
meta.membership_rule: Appearing in the minutes of a GUDECA meeting is NOT the same as being a member. Guests, dignitaries and speakers attend. Only add a person to a chapter when membership is confirmed, not because a record names them.

meta.deceased_rule: A person recorded as deceased is listed with respect and NEVER carries a claim action. `deceased: true` removes the claim button and the 'not me' link; the entry stands as a record, not an invitation.
meta.body_rule: `body` is an office-holding body (see bodies.json); `chapter` is a place (see chapters.json). A person may have both, one, or neither. Thadeus Fon holds national office AND belongs to the Douala chapter.
meta.relationship_rule: Family relationships stated privately by a member of the community are NOT published here. If a relationship belongs on the site, it comes from the Palace record or from the person themselves.
meta.palace_family_rule: The Fondom confirmed on 16 September 2026 that there is one Fomuki family in Guneku and that it is the Palace family. That is a fact about Guneku recorded in this file, and it is NOT a rule any code may apply: nothing derives a place around the throne from a name, and `body` remains the only thing that places anybody there. A new Fomuki still needs the Fondom to confirm the person before an entry is opened, and membership of the family never carries an office, a title, Notable standing or a stated relationship to the reigning Fon — each of those is established on its own or not at all.
